deploy.on_merge: A merge to main changes nothing on sinovai.com. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) checks syntax, runs the tests and the Surface conformance check, and dry-builds the Worker (`wrangler versions upload --dry-run`). The merge also starts a Vercel Production build of the repository root (Git-connected project sinovai), which serves only redirects to sinovai.com (vercel.json); .vercelignore leaves brand/ out of it. sinovai.com is the Worker, released by hand: `npm run release:upload` (a new Worker version, now with the ./public assets directory) and then promotion by the owner session, following RECOVERY.md.
deploy.after_deploy: RECOVERY.md: re-read the deployment status and script ETag, stop if anything changed, GET-check the routes at a staged allocation, then promote. The [assets] directory is new with this kit: at the 0% override, also GET /og.jpg (expect image/jpeg, 56,609 bytes, equal to brand/kit/web/og.jpg); whether version overrides route static assets was not tested before this kit. After promotion, run brandkit-doorcheck on https://sinovai.com/. The memory note sinovai-duality (2026-07) records propagation skew: the first request after a deploy may reach the old version.
deploy.rules: AGENTS.md: ask before push, external publication, deployment or credential changes, and run npm run check, npm test, npm run test:surface and npm run build after Worker changes.

notes: The Worker (src/worker.js, routes sinovai.com/* and www.sinovai.com/*) serves every page. The HTML lives in template literals in src/pages/*.js; site.html lists the six museum rooms (not a glob: museum-catalogue.js and room-creation.js in the same folder hold no head). Each carries the kit's theme-color and color-scheme; icons: false because no icon is served.

/og.jpg is served from ../public, the Worker's static assets directory (wrangler.toml [assets], no binding). Static assets answer before the Worker runs, so that one path never reaches it; every other path still does. public/og.jpg is a copy of kit/web/og.jpg, and this check compares them.

The home page (src/pages/door.js) carries the snippet's social lines (og:*, twitter:card) as kit/web/head-snippet.html writes them, without its icon and manifest links. head-home.html (Organization JSON-LD) is not used: its logo is the monogram icon.

Known differences, by design: the card is set in Shippori Mincho, not the page's Cormorant Garamond and Noto Serif TC (generator 1.8 sets cards in the wordmark's face, and only faces bundled with vectorcraft-cli or installed can be outlined; review 2026-11-02 §4.5, generator 1.9); its title is the kit's dark text role #F7F7F5 and its subtitle #A4A199, a step brighter than the page's #e9e6df and #8a877e (generator 1.8 derives them from the neutral scale).
check.mjs is not wired yet; planned: `npm run test:brand` (node brand/check.mjs) as a step in .github/workflows/ci.yml, beside npm test. A new blocking step is the owner's choice.
/favicon.ico and /apple-touch-icon.png answer the Worker's 404 page, and will until the owner chooses a mark (re-checked locally 2026-11-10).
